method: Exa official-page review plus direct official HTML credit and policy-link verification

policyEvidence.licenseGrantExcerpt: ESA/Hubble images, videos and web texts are released under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International license
policyEvidence.creditExcerpt: The full image or footage credit must be presented in a clear and readable manner to all users, with the wording unaltered
policyEvidence.thirdPartyExcerpt: Images and videos published on esahubble.org are, unless explicitly stated otherwise, cleared for reuse without needing to contact the individuals or organisations listed.

requirements: Show each complete unaltered credit clearly and visibly with its image.
Keep online source and license links active.
Mention subsequent significant visual changes; delivered JPEGs retain official bytes.
Do not imply ESA/Hubble endorsement or include controlled ESA/Hubble logos.

candidates.pageUsageText: Usage of ESA/Hubble Images and Videos Are you a journalist? Subscribe to the ESA/Hubble Media Newsletter.
candidates.basis: The individual image page links the ESA/Hubble usage policy and states no exception to its published reuse grant. The policy explicitly covers named third-party contributors without separate contact.
candidates.reviewedScope: Caption, full credit, image formats, usage link, and page-specific restrictions inspected using Exa full content and original official HTML; clearance is for the page-linked screen JPEG.
